title: Equipment Datasheet - CATALYST REDUCTION REACTOR (DC-3401A)
content:
EQUIPMENT DATASHEET: DC-3401A (CATALYST REDUCTION REACTOR).
Document No: TJC-LLD-DS-DC-3401A, Revision: Rev 3, Status: Issued for Operation.
Equipment Type: Fixed-Bed Reactor (Pd Catalyst).
Plant Unit: Linear Low Density Polyethylene (LLDPE) Unit, Area: 3400 – Catalyst Preparation.
Functional Location: TJC-LLD-3400-01, Criticality: High Critical.
Service: Reduction of PdO catalyst to Pd using H2 (PdO + H2 -> Pd).
MECHANICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Reactor Type: VERTICAL FIXED-BED, DOWNFLOW; Catalyst: Pd / Al2O3 (PdO reduced to Pd); Catalyst Volume: 3.2 m3; Diameter (ID): 1200 mm; Shell Material: SA-516 Gr.70 + SS304 clad; Tangent-Tangent: 4500 mm; Internals: SS304 support grid + hold-down; Design Pressure: 6 barg / FV; Heater: EA-3401 ELECTRIC PRE-HEATER 180 kW; Operating Pressure: 2 kg/cm2g; Inert Medium: NITROGEN; Design Temp.: 250 °C; Reductant: HYDROGEN (diluted in N2); Operating Temp.: 180-210 °C; PSV: PSV-3401 set 6 barg
PEFORMANCE DATA:
EA-3401 Heater Output: 180 kW; Heater Voltage: 380 V / 3 Ph / 50 Hz; Heater Current: 273 A; Heater Type: IN-LINE ELECTRIC, N2 STREAM; TIC Control: TIC-17343 (heater outlet); Bed TC's: TE-3401-1..8 multipoint; Area Classification: ZONE 1, IIC T3; Ex Protection: Ex d IIC T3; Driver Type: None (static vessel) - assoc. heater EA-3401
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-3401, Interlock: SEQ-3401.
